title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Risk-off, defensives held, energy bucked. Walmart’s comp miss sank staples and dragged SPY -0.84% while oil +2.77% on Iran rhetoric lifted XLE. Breadth skewed weak with only 3 sectors green, but losses stayed shallow—no 1% SPY break suggests orderly de-risking, not panic.

INDICES — VIX 16.0, below 20-day 16.2. Ranking: SOXX +0.52%, QQQ -0.72%, RSP -0.81%, SPY -0.84%, DIA -1.27%, IWM -1.34%. Large > small by 0.33pp. Oil +2.77% was the standout cross-asset move; TLT -0.82% led bond losses. SPY above 200-day, QQQ above.

VOLUME — SPY 1.0x avg, QQQ 0.9x—unremarkable attention. GLD/SLV 1.6x with prices up = accumulation in metals; IBB 1.9x on -2.83% = distribution in biotech. SOXX 0.6x on +0.52% = low-conviction bounce.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE Energy +0.27%, XLRE Real Estate +0.20%, XLB Materials -0.19%, XLK Technology -0.29%, XLC Comms -0.57%, XLU Utilities -0.57%, XLF Financials -0.92%, XLI Industrials -1.20%, XLP Staples -1.41%, XLY Discretionary -1.61%, XLV Healthcare -1.87%. Top: DRAM +4.43%, USO +2.77%. Bottom: XBI -3.64%, ITA -3.49%. Money out of rate-sensitive discretionary/healthcare into energy and metals—defensive rotation with an oil bid. Label: defensive risk-off.

POSITIONING — IWM PCR 1.83 signals heavy small-cap put demand; QQQ 1.03 elevated. SPY skew +4.0% = mild fear. VIX below 20-day = complacency despite red tape. IWM spot near 260 gamma flip—dealer hedging amplifying downside.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +2.77% pressuring staples via Walmart’s inflation warning and yields higher (TLT -0.82%) while gold +0.34% rose—inflation hedge bid despite risk-off. Silver +2.75% outpacing gold signals industrial-metal demand story intact.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 47.6 Neutral. DE +6.94% on 3.0x vol spike post-earnings accumulation; ISRG -5.84% and BSX -5.08% on insider-sale headlines, no fundamental catalyst. XBI -3.64% worst basket, momentum extreme. Watch: SLV +2.75% vol 1.6x signaling breakout continuation; IWM -1.34% near gamma flip 260; XLV -1.87% with IBB distribution—biotech weakness may extend.
